hack.root_cause: Proxy upgrade removed oracle access control — oracle price settable to arbitrary value → vault fully drained in atomic loop
hack.description: A routine oracle upgrade to Aevo's legacy Ribbon vaults accidentally removed access control on price-setting, giving the attacker a 6-day window to set prices to infinity and drain $2.7M.
